Safety.title: Safety Center
Safety.intro: A few simple habits go a long way toward trading safely, whether you're buying or selling.
Safety.tip1Title: Meet in a safe, public place
Safety.tip1Body: For local pickups, choose a well-lit public location, ideally during daytime.
Safety.tip2Body: Check that the item matches the listing description and photos before handing over any money.
Safety.tip3Title: Be wary of prices that seem too good to be true
Safety.tip3Body: Unusually low prices on high-value items are a common scam pattern.
Safety.tip4Body: Be cautious of anyone pushing you to move the conversation off AfroDeals early.
Safety.tip5Body: No legitimate buyer or seller needs an OTP or verification code sent to your phone.

Help.title: Help & Info
Help.buyingBody: Browse or search listings, and message a seller directly from a listing page to ask questions or arrange pickup. Always review a seller's listing details carefully before agreeing to buy.
Help.sellingBody: Tap "Post an ad", choose a category, and fill in the details buyers will want to know — price, condition, and location. You can edit or remove your listing at any time from "My listings".
Help.moreHelpBody: See our <safetyCenter>Safety Center</safetyCenter> for tips on trading safely.

Welcome.heroSub1: Buy and sell across African and European markets — arrange a pickup nearby and share a chat, or let a seller ship it to you wherever that works better.
Welcome.heroSub2: You're already part of it. Every trade, big or small, adds up.
Welcome.valueProp1Body: Land a great deal, find exactly what you were after, or finally clear space for what's next.
Welcome.valueProp2Body: Support a local seller or find a new home for something a neighbor needs.
Welcome.valueProp3Body: Give things a second, third, or fourth life, and help cut down on waste.
Welcome.aiTitle: Powered by AI, reviewed by you
Welcome.aiBody: Upload a single photo when you post an ad, and AfroDeals' AI suggests a title, a rich structured description, and the right category for you — automatically. You review and edit everything before anything goes live.
Welcome.aiBullet1: One photo does the work of three fields: title, description, and category
Welcome.aiBullet2: Every account gets 5 free AI uses to try it, no card required
Welcome.aiBullet3: You're always in control — nothing publishes without your review
Welcome.searchTipsHeading2: find it before anyone else does
Welcome.searchTipsIntro: A few habits that make the difference between scrolling and finding.
Welcome.searchTip1Body: Save a search from any results page and get a notification the moment something new matches.
Welcome.searchTip2Body: Narrow things down by category, price, or condition — but mix specific and broad terms so you don't miss a loosely-worded listing.
Welcome.searchTip3Body: Turn on notifications so you never miss a new listing, message, or offer the moment it happens.
Welcome.searchTip4Body: Bookmark listings you're interested in and find them anytime from My Favorites.
Welcome.searchTip5Body: The same item is often listed under more than one name — cast a wide net if your first search comes up short.
Welcome.searchTip6Body: Many sellers are open to offers. If a listing's been up a while, there's often room to move on price.
Welcome.dividerText: And once you've found something to sell yourself, here's how to make it shine.
Welcome.sellTipsHeading2: get it in front of the right buyer
Welcome.sellTipsIntro: A well-built listing sells faster. Here's what actually moves the needle.
Welcome.sellTip1Body: Bright, sharp photos from a few angles get more views — and more serious offers.
Welcome.sellTip2Body: Upload a photo when you post an ad and AfroDeals can suggest the right category and a title to start from.
Welcome.sellTip3Body: Include other common names for the item so more searches actually find your listing.
Welcome.sellTip4Body: List at a fixed price, leave it open to offers, or both — you decide how buyers can reach you on price.
Welcome.sellTip5Body: Mark whether you offer pickup, delivery, or both, so buyers know before they even message you.
Welcome.sellTip6Body: A fast reply to a message or an offer is often the difference between a sale and a missed one.
Welcome.buySellIntro: There's more than one way to close a deal on AfroDeals.
Welcome.trade1Body: Many sellers welcome bids — propose a fair price and see where the conversation goes.
Welcome.trade2Body: Some listings are fixed-price — skip the back-and-forth and message the seller to arrange it.
Welcome.trade3Body: As a seller, choose whether to accept offers or hold firm on your asking price — it's up to you.
Welcome.payShipIntro: AfroDeals is where you connect — how you pay and how the item changes hands is something you work out together, safely.
Welcome.pay1Body: AfroDeals connects buyers and sellers directly — agree on a payment method that works for you both, and keep the conversation on-platform until you do.
Welcome.pay2Body: Every listing shows whether the seller offers pickup, delivery, or both, so you know how a trade could work before you reach out.
Welcome.pay3Body: For local pickups, choose a public, well-lit spot — our Safety Center has more tips for trading with confidence.
Welcome.safetyIntro: A few simple habits go a long way, whether you're buying or selling.
Welcome.safetyTip1Body: Check that the item matches the listing's photos and description before handing over any money.
Welcome.safetyTip2Title: Meet in a safe, public place
Welcome.safetyTip2Body: For local pickups, a well-lit public location — ideally during daytime — is always the safer choice.
Welcome.safetyTip3Body: No genuine buyer or seller will ever need an OTP or verification code sent to your phone. Treat any such request as a scam.
Welcome.closingTitle: Ready to find your next great deal?
Welcome.closingBody: Search thousands of listings, or post your own in a couple of minutes.
